_note: Shared config for components/decomposer/run_decomposer.py, MetaQA questions. Per-model prompt style, generation, loader, few-shot and post-processing settings live in components/decomposer/models/<model>/config.json. v1 carried these as argparse defaults inside each copy of decomposer.py. questions_format 'lines' is the MetaQA plain-text question file format (one question per line); the MuSiQue variant lives in configs/decomposer_musique.json and does not change anything here.
_hop_source_note: 'gold' is the MetaQA path's behaviour, unchanged: a guided run injects the hop depth of the question file the question was read from. The router-guided source ('predictions', joined on a query id) is a MuSiQue condition and needs a question source that carries ids, which 'lines' files do not; the field names are declared here anyway so this config states the interface rather than leaving a required key missing.
_few_shot_exemplar_hop_count_note: v1 behaviour, unchanged: in a guided MetaQA run every few-shot exemplar's 'Hop count:' line states the QUERY's hop count. Jahid's 2026-08-19 decision to state each exemplar's own gold step count instead was taken for the MuSiQue conditions (configs/decomposer_musique.json sets 'exemplar_gold'), so it is not applied here: changing it would change MetaQA guided prompts, which no one asked for. Verified 2026-08-19 that this path renders exactly as before.

few_shot._ordering_note: Present the k retrieved exemplars in retrieval-rank order, highest similarity first - the MetaQA path's behaviour since v1, unchanged. The key exists in both shared configs because run_decomposer.py requires it rather than defaulting it; the full statement of what the values mean, and why 'complexity_asc' is reserved but refused, is in configs/decomposer_musique.json where the ordering experiment lives (supervisor assignment A5, ADR 0032 item 5).

logging._anchor_ids_file_note: Anchor prompt logging is OFF on the MetaQA path, and null is the way to say so rather than the way to leave it unsaid - the runner requires this key in every shared config. The 45 anchor ids (ADR 0033) are MuSiQue ids drawn from the ADR 0007 pinned 600, and this path's questions come from a 'lines' file that carries no ids at all, so there is nothing to join them onto. A MetaQA run therefore logs exactly what it logged before: the every-Nth prompt sample of the per-model 'logging.prompt_log_every'. Its metrics record anchor_prompts_logged 0 / anchor_prompts_expected 0. If an anchor set is ever drawn for MetaQA, point this key at it.
